english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something foolish, thoughtless, or amusingly stupid.
Use 傻 as the all-purpose colloquial word for a person or an action that is foolish.
This is the all-purpose choice for calling someone or an idea foolish or silly.
This is the all-purpose choice for calling a person stupid or foolish as an insult.

examples.english: You're so silly to believe something that simple!
examples.traditional: 你咁傻，連咁簡單嘅嘢都信㗎！

examples.english: You’re so daft you can’t even do such a simple question.
